_comment: Run the DbspNet engine (a .NET DBSP implementation) head-to-head with Feldera,
the closest engine class (streaming IVM / DBSP). SF=3 smoke shape.
Prerequisite: check out the dbsp-net repo as a sibling of ivm-bench (D:/src/dbsp-net
next to D:/src/ivm-bench), with its engineered-wood submodule initialised:
or set DBSPNET_REPO to its path.
